item.title: Verdin Park deeds made public as council appoints lawyer in hospital car park row
item.description: The council’s right to lease Verdin Pork for a hospital car park has been questioned by campaigners, who claim NTC’s legal relationship to the park is that of trustee, not beneficial owner.

item.title: Murder mystery night for guests to unravel back by popular demand
item.description: A MURDER mystery night is back by popular demand.

item.title: Update on three casualties taken to hospital after two-car crash
item.description: The incident was on Chester Lane, Winsford, at around 6.30pm yesterday, Wednesday.

item.title: Work to start on long-awaited bypass after council appoints main contractor
item.description: Middlewich Eastern Bypass will connect Pochin Way in the north of Middlewich to the A533 Booth Lane in the south, and include two new bridges over the Sandbach-Northwich railway line and the Trent and Mersey Canal.

item.title: Teen rock star hopefuls thrash it out for coveted gig at this summer's Deva Fest
item.description: The event is organised by The Nest Northwest, an award-winning grass roots youth music programme which sees industry professionals coach youngsters in all aspects of practical ensemble playing and performance.

item.title: Prisoner jailed for breaking into home with machete has year added to sentence
item.description: A SERVING prisoner from Northwich who was jailed for breaking into the home of an alleged paedophile while armed with a machete has had a year added to his sentence.

item.title: Harasser sent threatening texts to his ex about killing her and her family
item.description: William Gurney said he would kill his ex – by setting alight her house or slitting her throat – and also kill his ex's family members.

item.title: Dealer with 180 bags of cocaine in 'man bag' fled though woods to evade capture
item.description: Ibrahim Rahman, of St George’s Road, Winsford, abandoned a white Seat Leon by the River Weaver in the village after police tried to pull him over for driving dangerously on Saturday, November 29.

item.title: Update after car crashes into pond near salt mine as owner is 'safe and well'
item.description: The emergency services were on Bradford Road, near the salt mine, after 8am on Thursday, January 22.

item.title: Ex-CEO of Homes England to be interim chief executive of combined authority
item.description: Nick Walkley, ex-Homes England chief, set to become interim CEO of Cheshire and Warrington Combined Authority, leading £650m devolution investment.
